$comment: What this repository borrows from the dotfiles harness, and what it deliberately
does not. The dotfiles harness deploys into an agent home directory (~/.claude,
00_meta/skills, 00_meta/patterns). None of that exists here: this is a static
site with two registries and a CI guard. Porting the deploy machinery would
import a contract with no second party.
So this manifest is an inventory, not a deployment plan. scripts/check-harness.mjs
asserts that every file named in `enforced` exists and is non-empty, which is the
only thing the inventory can get wrong. The `not_ported` entries are recorded so
their absence reads as a decision rather than an oversight; each names the reason
it cannot apply, and a reason that stops being true is the cue to revisit it.

not_ported.why: The SOTA manifest's `targets`/`doctrine`/`agents`/`skills`/`bind` keys drive a writer that deploys into an agent home directory. Nothing here consumes them, and a manifest with keys no consumer reads is the drift this file exists to prevent. Only the inventory keys above were kept.
Personas are a vault runtime concept (architect, builder, curator, hermes-*). This repository has one agent context and no dispatch layer to select a persona with.
The vault skill catalogue is deployed by dotfiles setup into ~/.copilot/skills. Copying it here would fork the catalogue and let the two copies diverge.
Maps vault globs (specs/**, 00_meta/**) to skills. This repository has neither the globs nor the skill loader.
Routing and capability tables for the multi-model agent harness. CI here runs one fixed reviewer chain declared in harness/reviewer-pool.json; a second model table would be a second source of truth.
Quota bookkeeping for the Nan provider seat. Quotas are consumed by the harness CLI, not by a GitHub workflow.
Describes the upstream pr-agent release this repo pins. The pin lives in .github/workflows/pr-agent.yml and .pr_agent.toml; a third copy would need its own guard to stay honest.
Validate the agent and skill records above, which are not ported. The schema without the records validates nothing.
